fonts.__note: FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE closure (the altitude precedent). NOT A GUESS: MUI's own typography declaration — @mui/material createTypography defaults fontFamily '"Roboto", "Helvetica", "Arial", sans-serif' with fontWeightRegular 400 / fontWeightMedium 500 / fontWeightBold 700 (examples/mui/.mui-sandbox/node_modules/@mui/material/styles/createTypography.js:23-30), and every committed captured truth spells the stack 'Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif'. fontWeightLight 300 exists but only h1/h2 render it and no captured component mounts either. Files committed under extract/computed/fonts/roboto/ from @fontsource/roboto@5.3.0 (exact-pinned in examples/mui/.mui-sandbox/package.json). Inlined as data: URIs — no network at render or check time; same files + same pinned Chromium => same rasters on the recording platform.

components.__note: STATE-PLANE PROJECTION ROUND — `checked` RECLASSIFIED from a stateProp to a VARIANT AXIS (the Checkbox/Accordion precedent). `checked` is not a pseudo-class plane: it is a rendering a PROP selects, and it was outside the closed state vocabulary, so its captured deltas minted `<channel>-state-checked` names that re-parsed as nothing and that no emitter rendered. As an axis the same deltas become BASE-PLANE per-axis facts, the Figma variant grid picks the axis up, and the checked thumb's translate rides the overlay-cluster synthetic translate-x/y door.

components.__note: ORGANISM ROUND — Checkbox. Tri-state on ONE axis: MUI spells the tri-state as TWO independent booleans (checked + indeterminate), but the svg-content promotion carries per-value glyph assets only when the markup is a function of exactly ONE axis (svg-content-multi-axis refusal otherwise) — so the axis value expands into several library props through the $props grammar. All THREE glyphs (unchecked box, checked box, indeterminate dash) become distinct assets. disableRipple pinned (the Button/Switch precedent — the ripple never settles).

components.__note: ORGANISM ROUND — TablePagination (component='div', the composition every real table ships). count/rowsPerPage/page pinned so the rendered text is deterministic ('1–3 of 3'). The rows-per-page Select is pinned CONTROLLED-CLOSED (slotProps.select.open=false): the census active-driver's mouse.down lands on it, opens the MUI menu, and the select icon's 180° open rotation PERSISTED into the next sweep — a witnessed double-run byte-identity refusal (same determinism-pin class as Menu/Dialog transitionDuration:0). NAMED RESIDUE: at count=3 / rowsPerPage=10 / page=0 BOTH arrow IconButtons are forced Mui-disabled by the component itself — the ENABLED arrow colors are unobservable at this combo and are NOT in the captured truth (a paging axis would need a second fixed combo; deliberately out of v1).
components.name: Pagination

components.__note: ORGANISM ROUND — the composed DataTable, the first ORGANISM through the pipeline. NAMED EXCLUSIONS (v1): (1) stickyHeader is NOT captured — position:sticky has no carried spelling (contract-schema position = relative|static|absolute) and the sticky header also flips border-collapse to separate and paints its own background; (2) the row overflow MENU is captured CLOSED — an open Menu portals a root to document.body and the single-portaled-root policy would DROP the in-stage table; (3) TableSortLabel carries direction='asc' only — the direction axis is excluded by name (the -directionAsc/-directionDesc classes are also excluded from classAllow so a stray axis can never branch the union); (4) TableContainer/Paper is NOT the captured root — enumerated axes ride the ROOT mount and `size` is a Table prop, so the organism IS the Table (Paper elevation is already a captured component this round); (5) rows are INLINED, not component refs — promotion emits no component/repeat/slot refs, and MUI's size='small' descendant rule restyles the nested Checkbox's own padding (42x42 -> 24x24) with UNCHANGED child classes, so composing the standalone Checkbox contract would be WRONG in small tables; (6) TWO body rows, not three — repeated siblings are separate parts under a GLOBAL naming counter (label, label-2, ...), so the sample is the minimum that proves both the plain and the selected/checked row; (7) the row-action control carries a TEXT glyph, not an icon asset — the childrenSpec grammar mounts imported COMPONENTS and @mui/icons-material is not in the pinned sandbox; raw SVG markup in config is deliberately NOT invented this round.
